tier_reason: Tier unchanged (theoretical README table only). Usability corrected from copyable to reference on the enricher's reading of HEAD: float64_t, float59_t and float43_t are empty ulong wrappers with no operators, the only MetalFloat64 source is a placeholder increment(uint) marked 'TODO: Remove this entire file', and the README's float32x2_t does not exist in the code, so there is no FP64 arithmetic to copy.

corrections.caveats: HEAD contains no FP64 arithmetic: float64_t/float59_t/float43_t are empty ulong wrappers with no operators; the only MetalFloat64 source is a placeholder increment(uint) marked 'TODO: Remove this entire file'; the README's float32x2_t does not exist in the code. MetalAtomic64 fetch_add ignores the type id (an f64 add would be an integer add) and the device store has no lock. The header copies Apple Metal stdlib code under Apple copyright, so MIT does not cover all of it. The README Performance table is theoretical peak from instruction counts, not a measurement; archived 2024-08-11.
